why_best: Evolving the narrative anchor directly in place maintains maximum engagement while emphasizing that the new state is the direct evolution of the old.
why_bad: Sweeping elements offscreen or cutting away forces the audience to re-orient their focus, breaking the conceptual link between cause and effect.
trap: A subtle misalignment between the focal centers of the outgoing and incoming content will create a jarring jump that destroys the illusion of continuous identity.
